subject: english
question:
**Change the following sentence into the Active form.**

The famous painter was seen to be walking in the park.

options.text: Someone saw the famous painter walking in the park.
The famous painter walked in the park and was seen.
The park was where the famous painter was seen walking.
Someone has seen the famous painter walking in the park.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
 

• Active voice structure: The subject performs the action described by the verb, and the object receives the action. 

• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice becomes the subject of the passive sentence. 

• In the given passive sentence, "The famous painter was seen to be walking in the park," the subject is "The famous painter" and the action is "was seen to be walking."
